blocks.orig: Located along the paradisical beach between Bwejuu and Paje on the east coast of Zanzibar, the Baraza Resort & Spa is a five-star boutique resort with 30 luxuriously appointed villas. This stunning all-inclusive resort evokes the heritage of Zanzibar dating back to the era of the Sultans, with a fusion of Arabic, Swahili and Indian design with Swahili arches, Arabic antiques, handmade furniture and Indian brass lanterns.
blocks.html: The Baraza Resort & Spa is a five-star boutique resort on Zanzibar's east coast, on the idyllic stretch of beach that runs between Bwejuu and Paje. It has 30 villas, all luxuriously furnished. The all-inclusive resort brings back the Zanzibar of the Sultans' era: Arabic, Swahili and Indian design come together in Swahili arches, Arabic antiques, furniture made by hand and brass lanterns from India.

blocks.orig: There are five types of villas at Baraza, with each one or two bedrooms, walk-in dressing rooms, freestanding bathtubs, and plunge pools. Spread over the spacious garden and along the beach, these villas make you feel like you are in a 1001-night fairytale. With the Dhahabu Bar & Lounge, the Livingstone Terrace Restaurant, the Ocean Lounge, a grand swimming pool and the beach at your bare feet, Baraza provides beautiful moments all throughout the day. All in all, this resort offers a little piece of heaven on one of the most beautiful beaches in the world.
blocks.html: You can choose from five kinds of villa at Baraza. Each has one or two bedrooms, plunge pools, freestanding bathtubs and walk-in dressing rooms. Scattered through the spacious garden and along the shore, they feel like something out of a 1001-night fairytale. Thanks to the Dhahabu Bar & Lounge, the Livingstone Terrace Restaurant, the Ocean Lounge, a big pool and the sand right under your bare feet, there is something lovely to enjoy at every hour of the day. All in all, it is a small slice of heaven on a beach that ranks among the most beautiful in the world.
